head: Gemini camera on Android redesigned: it now opens inside your chat
dek: The camera you open from the plus menu in Gemini's prompt box now slides up as a sheet over your chat on Android, instead of a separate full-screen viewfinder. It has rolled out widely with Google app version 17.76 and later, after reaching the iPhone app first.
details: You can drag the sheet up to fill most of the screen, and it runs almost edge to edge. The capture button sits in the middle, with a three-dot button beside it for flash and the front camera, and a back button on the other side; swiping down also closes it. Opening the camera from the Gemini overlay still shows the old full-screen viewfinder. 9to5Google reported the change on 21 November, a day after Gemini added GIF making.
where: Android (Google app 17.76 and later, beta and stable); already on iPhone
means: If you show Gemini photos to ask about them, you can now take the picture without leaving the conversation.
todo: Tap the plus in Gemini's prompt box and pick the camera. If you still see the old one, 9to5Google suggests force-stopping the Google app and opening Gemini again.
thumb_words: GEMINI CAMERA GETS A NEW LOOK
